references.author: Nippon Sharyo
references.observed: Manufacturer N700 family reference; V12 door joints conform to the inherited downloaded N700 body, not a conversion to N700A.

geometry: All new V12 passenger furnishings and exterior additions are native procedural meshes. Existing source meshes, including the original CC-BY subway interior and N700 asset, are retained with their prior credits.
limitations: Dimensions and small fittings are inferred and fitted to existing model envelopes, not manufacturer CAD.
Source car positions, formations and wheelbases are retained. Model seat totals are not certified capacities.
E233-3000 cab templates use representative semi-cross seating; formations and year-specific variants are not individually surveyed.
E5 special cars retain inherited window distributions; detailed seat design and spacing are simplified.
N700 interior is retained; V12 adds exterior door outlines, not a complete N700 cabin rebuild.
Photo dates differ; this is not a single-date digital twin.
